reason: A reproducible science workbench for running analysis cells, generating and reviewing figures, and recording artifact provenance, feedback, environments, hashes, and local Git history.

summaries.zh: 用于运行科学分析单元、生成和审阅图表，并记录产物溯源、反馈、环境、哈希与本地 Git 历史的可复现工作台插件。
summaries.en: A reproducible science workbench plugin for running analysis cells, generating and reviewing figures, and recording artifact provenance, feedback, environments, hashes, and local Git history.

capabilities: Executes user-supplied Python or shell cells in fresh subprocesses
Reads, writes, moves, and deletes project files and generated artifacts
Creates and updates project manifests, environment snapshots, hashes, and local Git commits
Provides a browser workbench for viewing figures, provenance, feedback, and cell history
